questions.prompt: Lucene's storage design most resembles which earlier structure?
options: Immutable SSTable segments in a log-structured engine
A new document becomes searchable only after the next refresh

questions.prompt: Which write-ahead log does Elasticsearch append every operation to for durability? (one word)
How does Lucene delete a document from an immutable segment?
options: It removes it from the postings in place
It sets a bit in the segment's live-docs bitmap

questions.prompt: How does Lucene update a document?
Many small segments make searches slow, so a merge policy combines them in the background.
Why does Lucene store doc values alongside the inverted index?
options: Sorting and aggregations need each document's field value, which an inverted index is bad at
